vetSays.line: 🛡️ Emmett, Ingrid, Zahra, James and Ethan met them at the door — 4 put down. Zahra didn't come back. Emmett, James, Ethan are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
Scarred The Glow Stag's Antler Sweep hits you for 3.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
You STRIKE the Scarred The Glow Stag for 118 (Hardlight knife).
Caleb strikes the Scarred The Glow Stag.
Caleb hits Scarred The Glow Stag for 30.
Scarred The Glow Stag is BLEEDING — and it likes it. Louder, faster, no more feints.
Scarred The Glow Stag's Antler Sweep hits you for 3.
It should drop — but the light behind Scarred The Glow Stag's eyes is already gathered. The body won't fall until it fires.
You STRIKE the Scarred The Glow Stag for 91 (Hardlight knife).
Caleb hits Scarred The Glow Stag for 10.
The Scarred The Glow Stag falls.
You cut it down — but the light was already in its eyes. Scarred The Glow Stag's death throes loose the beam.
Scarred The Glow Stag's Ocular Discharge hits you for 32.
🛡️ Emmett, James, Dale, Maya and Tariq met them at the door — 5 put down. Emmett, James, Dale, Maya, Tariq are hurt.
🛡️ Emmett, Kavya, Mxolisi, James and Dale met them at the door — 5 put down. Emmett, Kavya, Mxolisi, Dale are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Emmett, Kavya, Mxolisi, James and Dale met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Emmett, Mxolisi, Dale are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Maya just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Emmett, Kavya, Mxolisi, James and Ethan met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Kavya, Mxolisi, James, Ethan are hurt.
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader Chorus Line (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
Dale strikes the Pack-leader Chorus Line.
The Pack-leader Chorus Line falls.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Dale just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
◈ THE WAR PATH — A moment of respect, from something that rarely respects. On day 87, Emmett put down Loud-Eyes. On day 83, Emmett put down Big-Eyes — and 1 more tooth after.
"THE HERALD came. Named and located — the war council knew its face. Even now the wave-5 bar reads: blood your fighters (0 of 2 veterans)." — the System is still reading the list.
